test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: general
question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 50°, BE and CF are perpendiculars on AC and AB at E and F, respectively. BE and CF intersect at H. The bisectors of ∠HBC and ∠HCB intersect at P. ∠BPC is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angle at Orthocenter (H): ∠BHC = 180° − ∠A

Angle at Incenter (P) of ΔHBC: ∠BPC = 90° + ∠BHC / 2

Combining the two: ∠BPC = 90° + (180° − ∠A) / 2 = 180° − ∠A / 2

Substituting ∠A = 50°: ∠BPC = 180° − 50° / 2 = 180° − 25° = 155°.

**∴ The correct answer is 155°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ∠A = 50° in ΔABC. BE and CF are altitudes intersecting at H. P is the intersection of bisectors of ∠HBC and ∠HCB.

**Formula Used:**

1. Angle formed by altitudes at orthocenter: ∠BHC = 180° − ∠A

2. Angle formed by interior angle bisectors in ΔHBC: ∠BPC = 90° + ∠BHC / 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9586d56be3ec3232d064967b43f1d22e705be8661895ac6a6edd8d922b6ec714.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In quadrilateral AFHE, ∠AFH = 90° and ∠AEH = 90°.

⇒ Sum of angles in AFHE = 360°

⇒ ∠A + ∠AFH + ∠AEH + ∠FHE = 360°

⇒ 50° + 90° + 90° + ∠FHE = 360°

⇒ ∠FHE = 360° − 230° = 130°

⇒ ∠BHC = ∠FHE = 130° (Vertically opposite angles)

⇒ In ΔHBC, P is the incenter because it is the intersection of angle bisectors.

⇒ ∠BPC = 90° + ∠BHC / 2

⇒ ∠BPC = 90° + 130° / 2

⇒ ∠BPC = 90° + 65° = 155°.

**∴ The correct answer is 155°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Orthocenter Property

The angle subtended by any side at the orthocenter (H) is supplementary to the opposite vertex angle: ∠BHC + ∠A = 180°.

Incenter Angle Formula

The angle formed by interior angle bisectors at the incenter (I) is ∠BIC = 90° + ∠A / 2.

Circumcenter Angle Formula

The angle subtended by a side at the circumcenter (O) is twice the angle at the vertex: ∠BOC = 2 × ∠A.

Ex-center Angle Formula

The angle formed by the intersection of exterior angle bisectors at the ex-center (E) is ∠BEC = 90° − ∠A / 2.</p
